verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a broad API surface. It supports creating, updating and deactivating controls, uploading and deleting contracts, bulk-managing documents, policies, owners and offboarding, running audit operations, and managing questionnaire responses. An MCP server also lets agents act on compliance data. No evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and many UI product areas have no documented endpoints in the pack, so the parity story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity commitment, documented API coverage for Trust Center, access reviews, risk management, TPRM and the Vanta AI Agent features, a public OpenAPI spec (probes 404'd), and hands-on corroboration of parity.
